mapper.insert: INSERT INTO openbank_token( member_id, access_token, refresh_token, expires_at, user_seq_no ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{accessToken}, #{refreshToken}, #{expiresAt}, #{userSeqNo} )
mapper.select: SELECT token_id, member_id, access_token, refresh_token, expires_at, created_at, user_seq_no FROM openbank_token WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
